scientific_integrity: A mathematical derivation constructs the radial and first-harmonic cyclic subspaces and computes the exact full position-basis orthogonal projector. Exact rational projector tests in dimensions two through seven and finite-field Krylov tests are finite corroborations, not infinite proof or independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: One-particle uniform-hopping hypercube; all weight-one absorber sites and strictly positive individual losses; eventual capture, not decay-time optimization. General Hamming-shell bright ranks and single-corner capture values were already known and are not claimed novel. Literature comparison does not establish absolute historical priority.
title: Exact capture projector for Hamming-neighbor absorbers on a quantum hypercube
